messages.subject: Re: C++11
parts:
Linas,

shinyapps.io has gcc-4.6, which I don't thinks supports c++11 fully (only c++0x is supported I believe). Uploading a binary will not work because it will be linked against a newer version of libstdc++.

-Andy
